subject: SCCs execution approach & evidence pack request — MedAlign procurement
messages:
From: Sarah Holmes <sarah.holmes@medalign.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: procure@medalign.com
Date: Sun, 14 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: SCCs and evidence pack request for procurement window

Hi Kimberly / Laura,

Thanks for the demo last week. Procurement has asked us to confirm the SCCs approach and collect a compact evidence package (SOC 2 attestation, CAIQ/SSP highlights, DPIA summary) to move the contract to legal review. Attached is a short questionnaire from our side that maps to the SCCs and required evidence.

Key asks from MedAlign:
- Which SCCs module will Redwood sign for controller -> processor flows (we are the controller for PHI-derived analytics)?
- Do you include the UK Addendum for transfers involving UK entities?
- Can you provide a short DPIA risk summary and SOC 2 Type II report redacted version?
- Timeline target: procurement wants legal review by week of 28 Feb.

Can you confirm a path and expected dates for the evidence pack? If easier, we can set a 30 minute call with procurement this week.

Attachments: MedAlign_SCCs_questionnaire.pdf

Best,
Sarah Holmes
Head of Procurement | MedAlign Health

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Holmes <sarah.holmes@medalign.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 14 Feb 2027 10:05:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: SCCs and evidence pack request for procurement window

Hi Sarah — thanks, and great to meet the procurement ask. Short answer up front: we expect to execute the Controller->Processor SCCs (Module 2) for the primary agreement, include the UK Addendum for UK transfers, and provide an addendum/Module 4 path for subprocessors where required.

What we will deliver by the week of 21 Feb (to allow legal review before your 28 Feb target):
- Draft SCCs (Module 2) with our standard redlines + UK Addendum draft (DocuSign-ready).
- Redacted SOC 2 Type II report and CAIQ summary highlights.
- DPIA summary & high-level data flow mapping (one page) + a short risk register.
- Execution options: DocuSign link for immediate signing OR a countersigned PDF if your legal needs tracked redlines.

I attached our internal "SCCs execution playbook" and a DPIA summary workbook so you can see the deliverable formats. Laura / Neha / Vivek — looping you in to confirm the legal/security redlines below and to assign owners for each artifact.

Questions for MedAlign:
1) For clarity, you noted you are the controller. Can you confirm which EU/UK entity will sign and whether there are downstream transfers to the US?
2) Do you need a full SSP or will the CAIQ highlights + SOC2 suffice for procurement?

Proposed next step: 30-minute sync Friday to confirm scope if that works for your team.

Attachments: redwood_sccs-execution-playbook_v1.pdf, dpiarisk-summary.xlsx

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Senior Contracts Manager | Redwood Inference

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Sarah Holmes <sarah.holmes@medalign.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 14 Feb 2027 11:20:00 -05:00
Subject: RE: SCCs and evidence pack request for procurement window

Hi all — quick legal note to put the recommended approach on the record:

1) Primary path: Module 2 (controller -> processor). This is appropriate because MedAlign will be the controller for the analytics dataset.
2) Subprocessor flows: we will add Module 4 language where Redwood acts as a processor and the data is passed to a downstream processor (subprocessor). We'll surface our current subprocessors list in the evidence pack; any new subprocessor will require the standard notification / objection windows.
3) UK transfers: we will attach the UK Addendum alongside the EU SCCs (DocuSign-ready). The Addendum will be executed by both parties.
4) Key redlines we expect from customer legal: audit rights (narrowed to security/incident-related audits), breach notification timing (ours: 72 hours initial notification), and subprocessors listing cadence. We can accept minor commercial redlines but will push back on open-ended security obligations.

Deliverables: I attached the working drafts for the Module 2 document and the UK Addendum. Kimberly — can you confirm who at MedAlign will be the signatory (EU legal entity) and whether there are any required clause swaps on liability caps? I will prepare a short memo explaining why Module 2 + UK Addendum is the cleanest path (faster to execute vs bespoke transfers).

Attachments: sccs-module-2-draft.docx, uk-addendum-draft.docx

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Counsel, Privacy & Security | Redwood Inference

Kimberly / Neha — thanks for the quick responses. Confirming:
- MedAlign is the controller (EU entity: MedAlign Ltd, UK subsidiary will be part of the agreement).
- There will be downstream transfers to a US-based analytics partner (we will include that in the procurement questionnaire).

Procurement asks that the legal docs + evidence pack be available for review by 24 Feb so we can close by 28 Feb. If you can provide the documents by Monday (21 Feb), we should be in good shape.

We do require: redacted SOC 2 Type II, CAIQ highlights, DPIA summary, and the signed SCCs + UK Addendum (or DocuSign ready copy). Is it possible to get the SCCs + UK Addendum on DocuSign to speed execution?

Also cc'ing Oliver (legal) and procurement mailbox for scheduling.

Regards,
Sarah Holmes
